title: Kredibel: every number has a source

scenes.shot: Title card: Sunrise Coffee Roasters and a hundred documents a month (statements, ledger, invoices, receipts).

sentences.text: Meet Sunrise Coffee Roasters, a small coffee roaster in Bandung.
About a hundred documents a month: statements, a ledger, invoices and receipts.
But October cost more than it should have.
A missing record? A mistake? Or fraud?

scenes.shot: Card: the cost of fraud (ACFE 2024), then "Checking by hand takes days."

sentences.text: Organizations lose about 5% of revenue to fraud each year; for small businesses, the median case costs $141,000.
And checking every page by hand takes days.

scenes.shot: Card: the Kredibel logo and what it does.

sentences.text: That's where Kredibel comes in.
It reads every document, reconciles every month, and shows the evidence behind every number.

scenes.shot: Production: sign in with the demo account (email and password), the welcome question, "Check what I expect", two months of expectations, save.

sentences.text: Anyone can try the demo account, no Google account needed.
Kredibel first asks what you want.
Our owner wants to check a hunch.
September: 820 million in, 840 million out. October: a billion in, 620 million out.

scenes.shot: Dashboard for October: the figures, then the "What you expected" panel.

sentences.text: The dashboard checks the books against those expectations.
September is as expected; October's money out is 86 million over.
And 95 percent of bank lines were matched automatically.

scenes.shot: Transactions for October: the table, then a cash deposit in the drawer.

sentences.text: So where did the money go? Here is every October bank line.
Its category, IFRS and US GAAP class, subledger and match.
Even a cash deposit is explained: the ledger books it to sales.

scenes.shot: October's reconciliation: its explained risk, then the bank lines with the reason for each match.

sentences.text: Each month reconciles itself, whatever order the files arrived in.
Every match has its reason; the risk is explained with citations.

scenes.shot: Risk: October High (a supplier paid to a new bank account), then August Critical with the evidence on the page.

sentences.text: The risk page finds what the owner feared.
October is high: a supplier was paid into a new bank account.
August is critical: a statement was edited in a PDF editor.
One amount is in another font; the balance no longer adds up.

scenes.shot: Documents: July's invoice and a receipt photo arrive late with a copy of October's statement; the copy is not read; the invoice is read and its total shown on the page.

sentences.text: Files arrive in any order: a late July invoice, a receipt photo, and a statement copy.
The copy is spotted at once, never counted twice.
Gemini reads each new page.
And code checks each value is on the page before it counts.

scenes.shot: Review: the short queue of decisions.

sentences.text: Anything Kredibel can't decide for certain goes to one review queue.
A held copy, an unpaid invoice, a value to check.

scenes.shot: Labels (every AI decision with its confidence), then Runs (each workflow, its Gemini calls, tokens and cost).

sentences.text: Every AI decision is a label to confirm or correct.
And every run is traced: each Gemini call, its tokens and its cost.

scenes.shot: Assistant: "How much money went out in October?" and the cited answer.

sentences.text: And you can simply ask the books.
The assistant answers from the books' own figures, and cites each one.

scenes.shot: Production, signed out: Sign in with Google, then Set up your business signed in as the owner's Gmail, Start the free trial, the welcome question.

sentences.text: Ready to try your own books? Sign in with Google.
Set up your business once: its name, industry, currency and time zone.
The free trial starts in a workspace of your own.

scenes.shot: Closing card: Kredibel on Google Cloud (Firebase, Cloud Run, Firestore, Gemini, Document AI) and the demo sign-in.

sentences.text: Kredibel runs on Google Cloud: Firebase Hosting and Authentication, Cloud Run for the app and its ADK workflows, Firestore for the books, and Gemini with Document AI.
Try the demo, or your own books. Kredibel: every number has a source.
